name: BACH_0178
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
One-class conformal set; second model and all 5 neighbors agree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal >99%, Benign <1% | Sharply peaked |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.996; 64th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 3, 8) · ↓ invasive · Strongest negative association with invasive; score above typical [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Benign background; modest negative association · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 1, 4, 11) · context · Above-typical TILs; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 0, 3, 8) · context · 8% of nuclei, above 91% of reference; three regions only [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so concepts are not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and Weak TILs (8/20).

## Could be wrong if
- The normal-lobule concept failed its spot check (0/20), so its link to lower invasive likelihood is unverified.
- Cell sampling covered 3 of 12 regions and was flagged for insufficient tumor nuclei.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 0**: HoVer-Net labelled 13 nuclei neoplastic; confirm they are benign.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 8**: confirm genuine two-layered lobular epithelium; this concept failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 1, 4**: check the dense lymphocytes for hidden atypical epithelium or infiltrating tumor.
